data.name: Arcane Augmentation
data.description: A magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to grant himself a +%1 competence bonus for 1 minute to one of the following skills: Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Perception, Stealth, and Swim.|5+(MagusLVL-4)/3
